from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_cuts = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_cuts = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_ranges = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts)-1) if row_cuts[i]+1 < row_cuts[i+1]]
    col_ranges = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts)-1) if col_cuts[i]+1 < col_cuts[i+1]]
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers = [color for color in counts if color != background]
    marker = markers[0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) >= 2 else background
             for c0, c1 in col_ranges] for r0, r1 in row_ranges]
